name: evidence-reader
description: Makes Claude read documents, spreadsheets, data files and images completely and report back with a receipt for every claim: three read-only agents (documents, tabular data, images) with a shared evidence contract, bundled stdlib extractors for Office, PDF, CSV, JSON and XML, image conversion and cropping for fine print, and a report gate that sends an agent back when its report lacks a completeness checklist. It never creates or edits the files it reads.

enforcement.title: Report gate enforcement
enforcement.description: block: when an evidence-reader agent returns a report without the required sections, it is sent back to complete it, at most twice, then allowed to stop flagged as incomplete. warn: only warn you. off: the gate does nothing; the skills and agents stay available.
